Designer |live=yes |livedebut=''[[A Pocketful of Adventures]]'' |liveactor={{wp|Shō Kasamatsu}} }} '''Kageaki Hiyama''' (Japanese: '''桧山景明''' ''Hiyama Kageaki'') is a main character in ''[[A Pocketful of Adventures]]''. ==History== ===Past=== At school, Kageaki Hiyama was a very studious student who wanted to be a designer, for years he studied for that, but in his first job, he went into the sales sector, which completely demotivated him. During this time, he met two other designers, [[Syo Sawamura]] and [[Kenji Ebiwara]], who were friends of his, but moved away from Hiyama over time. Some time later, Hiyama left that company and joined ADventure, once again in the position of selling the company's services. ===Season One=== ==Character== ==Pokémon== This list is of the Pokémon used by Hiyama in [[PPA06]]. Hiyama had two other Pokémon used off-screen, as he faced Madoka in a 5 on 5 battle. {| class="roundtable" style="text-align:center; background: #{{red color}}; border: 3px solid #{{red color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{red color light}}" | Pokémon ! style="background:#{{red color light}}" | Role in the series ! style="background:#{{red color light}}" | Level ! style="background:#{{red color light}}" | First appearance |- | [[File:Spr 1g 067.png]]
{{p|Machoke}} | Machoke was the first Pokémon used by Hiyama in his battle against Madoka, where it faced Madoka's {{p|Kangaskhan}}. According to Hiyama, Machoke was chosen because he prepared the ground for Madoka's subsequent choices. Machoke was defeated by Madoka's {{p|Raichu}} in the next round. At the end of the episode, Hiyama asked Madoka for help to try to evolve his Machoke. | 48 | [[PPA06]] |- | [[File:Spr 1g 034.png]]
{{p|Nidoking}} | Nidoking was initially used to face Raichu in the next round, but Madoka chose to switch to Pidgeot, as part of Hiyama's strategy, Nidoking beat Pidgeot with a super effective {{m|Ice Beam}} move. | 49 | [[PPA06]] |- | [[File:Spr 1g 036.png]]
{{p|Clefable}} | Clefable was Hiyama's last choice in the battle against Madoka and an important part of his battle strategy. During the battle against Madoka's {{p|Charizard}}, Clefable managed to win relatively easily. Then, during the battle against {{p|Gyarados}}, Clefable used a strategy that consisted of using {{m|Minimize}} to increase Clefable's evasion. With a stroke of luck, Madoka managed to beat Clefable with a Hyper Beam from Gyarados, thus managing to win the match.
